Priya: Quick one 5: drafting comms for a rolling maintenance on 2024-11-12. NA / EU / APAC windows, each 2h. Putting a short status + email draft here. Please review.

Alex K.: Add 'no data loss' and link rollback runbook. Also call out pinned Dedicated behavior.

Priya: Will do. Draft status snippet below: 

Priya: "Status: Scheduled rolling maintenance.
Windows (UTC): NA 02:00-04:00, EU 06:00-08:00, APAC 12:00-14:00.
Impact: Temporary latency increases and reduced throughput (approx. 20-40%) during restarts. No data loss expected. Pinned Dedicated model versions will not auto-upgrade.
Action: Live updates on status.redwood.ai; contact eng-oncall@redwood.ai for urgent needs."

Jin: Suggest adding fallback routing note: requests may route to alternate regions or compatible model variants if capacity constrained.

Kate: Also add SLO line: 'No SLO changes expected; short impacts during restarts.' And ops contact in email.

Priya: Email subject draft: "Planned maintenance: rolling infra updates 5 Nov 12 (UTC)". Body short version: 

Priya: "Hi <customer>,
We will run rolling maintenance on Nov 12 in three regional waves. You may experience short latency spikes and reduced throughput while we restart services. We expect no data loss and will preserve pinned model versions.
If you need strict throughput during the window, reply to this email and we will discuss options.
We will post live updates on https://status.redwood.ai.
Thanks, Redwood Support"

deploy-bot: Created statuspage event evt-20241112-001 (staging). Use `/status-publish evt-20241112-001` to publish.

Jin: I'll own #1 and #2, will run smoke tests 1h before each wave.

Priya: I'll compile top-10 list and email template. Kate will QA + publish.
